formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P10 — TS Low-Overlap State-Surface Cartography, Phase-1 Lower-Bound×G1 Localization, Normalized Solve-Progress Matching, Boundary/Stage Decoupling, Support-Density Residualization, Within-Solve Matched-State Contrasts, Cross-Cohort/Method Transport & Structural-Specificity Stress Test
surviving_results: Low-overlap TS support is structurally absent inside G1.
At phase1_lb=7, nonempty-support conditional solve excess is positive with solve-level sign-flip support.
Annotation boundary remains nonpositive and unsupported after structural and availability matching.
lb7-minus-neighbor local contrast is directionally positive but not strong and is cohort-sensitive.
P7_BATCH4 carries a large positive lb7 local residual that survives method×broad-provenance standardization and is not controlled by one solve.
retired_or_limited_interpretations: G1 zero excess is not behavioral neutrality; conditional preference is undefined because low-overlap support availability is zero.
P10 hotspot ranking is exploratory and cannot be treated as confirmatory localization.
The lb7 local-neighbor advantage is not transport-stable across existing acquisition cohorts.
next_scientific_problem: Fresh outcome-blind naturalistic replication of low-overlap and lb7 conditional/local-contrast signals on solves selected before body outcomes are observed.
